brand_identity.concept: Noite de coquetel - Romantic, sophisticated, nocturnal fashion & beauty e-commerce

typography.heading_font: Cormorant Garamond, Italiana, Bodoni Moda, serif

symbols_and_motifs.monogram: CV monogram in delicate white thin line
symbols_and_motifs.hero_motif: Thin-line cherry branch/blossoms crossing top-right/bottom-left hero corner
symbols_and_motifs.brand_icons: Cocktail glass with cherry and red bow, thin-line cherry blossom
symbols_and_motifs.favorites_icon: Animated cherry & bow icon on toggle
symbols_and_motifs.provisional_badge: Badge 'Exemplo' with subtle cherry border on mock products

layout_architecture.hero_section: Dark Wine (#2E0014) with kinetic typography, masked line reveal, and subtle cherry branch overlay
layout_architecture.category_doors: 4 doors: Roupas, Acessórios, Maquiagem, Cosméticos in dark wine card containers with subtle hover spotlight
layout_architecture.product_grids: Warm Off-White (#FAF7F2) sections for maximum legibility and true-to-color clothing/makeup display
layout_architecture.editorial_marquee: Slow, smooth drifting marquee text on wine background: 'CHERRY VIBES • NOITE DE COQUETEL • MODA & BELEZA • EDICÃO LIMITADA'
layout_architecture.footer_section: Dark Wine (#2E0014) with high-contrast thin-line grid borders and brand signature

product_card.light_theme: bg-white border border-[#2E0014]/10 rounded-none shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 group

adaptive_selectors.clothes: Size picker (PP, P, M, G, GG) + Color dots
adaptive_selectors.makeup: Shade swatches with name preview (Ex: 'Vinho Império', 'Cereja Velvet')

admin_panel.mode: Operate Mode - Functional density, high contrast, clean data tables, search filters, modal product edit, stock management, order status badges
admin_panel.style: Clean dark/light toggleable panel with compact grids and quick actions

motion_and_effects.framer_motion: Staggered scroll reveals on product cards, line-mask reveal on hero text
motion_and_effects.hover_effects: Subtle image scale (1.03x), border glow in #B3122F

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='product-card-1', data-testid='cart-drawer-toggle')
testing_requirements.file_extension: JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) as set up in /app/frontend/src
